name: Freeport Nostr
description: Search Freeport Nostr events by kind, tag, and geohash radius for rides, services, and reputation data.

tools.name: nostr_search_intents
tools.description: Search Freeport ride/service/product intents (offers & requests). Filter by side, category/area topic tags, and an optional geographic radius. Results are decoded, expiry-filtered, and sorted nearest-first when a point is given.

side.description: offer = drivers/providers/sellers; request = riders/buyers; any = both

topics.description: Topic `t` tags to require (category/subcategory/area keys, e.g. "vn_hanoi", "ridesharing").

near.description: Filter & sort by distance from this point.

relaySideGeohash.description: Also narrow at the relay via a #g cover of the radius. Only effective if posts carry geohash-prefix tags; off by default.

since.description: Only events created at/after this unix-seconds time.

until.description: Only events created at/before this unix-seconds time.

relays.description: Override the relay set for this call (ws/wss URLs, max 10). Defaults to the server relays.

tools.name: nostr_search_reputation
tools.description: Fetch reputation signals for a pubkey: karma ratings (kind 32103) it received and deal receipts (kind 32104). Returns proven-deal count (both receipt halves present) and a karma summary. Note: scores are subjective and un-weighted here; do not treat as Sybil-proof.

pubkey.description: Subject pubkey (hex) to look up reputation for.

relays.description: Override the relay set for this call (ws/wss URLs, max 10). Defaults to the server relays.

tools.name: nostr_get_event
tools.description: Fetch one or more events by id. Returns the raw signed events.

relays.description: Override the relay set for this call (ws/wss URLs, max 10). Defaults to the server relays.

tools.name: nostr_profile
tools.description: Fetch NIP-01 profile metadata (kind 0) for one or more pubkeys — name, about, picture, nip05, lud16, etc. Optionally include each author's most recent notes (kind 1). General-purpose: works for any Nostr user, not just Freeport.

pubkeys.description: Hex pubkeys to fetch profiles for.

recentNotes.description: If >0, also fetch up to this many recent text notes (kind 1) per pubkey.

relays.description: Override the relay set for this call (ws/wss URLs, max 10). Defaults to the server relays.

tools.name: nostr_query_raw
tools.description: Escape hatch: run an arbitrary NIP-01 filter (kinds/authors/ids/tags/since/until/limit). Use the typed tools above when they fit. Returns raw signed events.

tags.description: Tag filters, e.g. {"t":["vn_hanoi"],"g":["w3gv"]}. Keys are single tag letters.

relays.description: Override the relay set for this call (ws/wss URLs, max 10). Defaults to the server relays.

tools.name: freeport_create_post
tools.description: Publish a Freeport intent — an OFFER (side "offer": driver/provider/seller) or a REQUEST (side "request": rider/buyer). Provide EITHER a `secretKey` (nsec or hex — the server builds, signs and publishes; use a DEDICATED agent key, never a personal one — it is used once and never stored) OR a pre-signed `event` (you sign locally; nothing secret reaches the server). Strict rate limits apply. Returns the published event id + addressable `d`.

secretKey.description: nsec or 64-hex private key. Used transiently to sign; never stored. Omit if passing a pre-signed `event`.

payload.description: Intent payload (from/to/location, payment, etc.) per the freeport://protocol resource.

expiresInMinutes.description: How long the post stays live (default 720). Max 30 days.

geohashes.description: Geohashes for location-scoped discovery. Each is expanded into all its prefixes (precision 1-6) so radius searches at any precision match.

d.description: Stable id to republish/replace an existing post; defaults to random.

event.description: A complete, signed Nostr event (kind 32101/32102). Use instead of secretKey to keep keys off the server.
